name: zothos
description: Connect Cursor or Grok Bot to a machine through zoth-relay MCP. Tools: status, list_dir, read_file, write_file, run_command.

ZOTH_RELAY_URL.title: zoth-relay base URL
ZOTH_RELAY_URL.description: Base URL of your zoth-relay instance (no trailing slash). MCP is reached at {base}/mcp.

ZOTH_RELAY_TOKEN.title: zoth-relay bearer token
ZOTH_RELAY_TOKEN.description: Bearer token created on the relay host. Set under Plugins → Configure. Never commit this value.
